claim: A11 / weakness 4: JEDI-linear's S and h4 units are individually nameable as (pT, r) hinge objects at a rate above random rotations of the same activations and comparable to SAE features, while Deep Sets / PFN units need an SAE to reach that rate

models.jedi: JEDI-linear official 3-feature n64 (interp.jedi_core.Jedi(64)); layers S (pooled second-round objects, 64) and h4 (64)
models.dsets: dsets-d64 float seed 0 (models/small/dsets-d64-n64/seed0/weights.npz); layer S = sum over particles of phi2 (64)
models.pfn: PFN (64,64,32) seed 0 (results/jedi/x9_models/pfn_64-64-32_s0); layer L = pooled latent (32)

sample.fit: interp.jedi_core.sample(per_class=5000, seed=0), 25,000 jets; fixed permutation rng(0): first 2/3 fit-train, last 1/3 fit-dev (term-count selection)
sample.test: sample(per_class=5000, seed=29) minus every jet also in the fit sample
sample.causal: 5,000 test jets drawn with rng(5), restricted to jets whose every edit stays inside JEDI-linear's l1 input fixed-point range (the same jets for all three models)
sample.bootstrap: B = 500 jet resamples of the test jets, rng(11), the same resample weights in every job (model contrasts paired)

live_units: std > 1e-6 on fit-train and value > 1e-6 on >= 0.5 % of fit-train jets

bases.rot_raw: 20 Haar-random orthogonal rotations (rng(100 + i)) of the raw live-unit activations (primary null)
bases.rot_std: 10 Haar-random rotations (rng(200 + i)) of the z-scored live-unit activations (secondary null)
bases.pca: the d principal directions of the raw live-unit covariance (fit-train)
bases.sae2x / sae4x: ReLU SAE, dictionary 2d / 4d (d = number of live units), input (h - mean) / s with s the rms per-dimension s.d.; f = ReLU(W_e (x - b_d) + b_e), x_hat = W_d f + b_d, unit-norm decoder rows; loss = mean squared error / d + lambda * mean sum f; Adam lr 1e-3, batch 512, 3000 steps, jax, 1 CPU; lambda = the largest of {0.3, 0.1, 0.03, 0.01, 0.003} with fit-dev fraction of variance unexplained <= 0.10 (else 0.003). Scored: top-k features, k = d, ranked by mean f^2 on fit-train (primary), and all features firing on >= 0.5 % of fit-train jets (secondary)

library: the E11 hand-built rank-window observables (interp.e11_mars_all.handbuilt: per-window N, sum pT, sum pT r^2, sum r^2, sum r, sum pT r, sum (r-0.2)+, N(pT>1), N(pT<2), sum r[r<0.165], N(pT<2, r>0.1) over windows all, top14, r1-63, r13-63, top39, top26, top3, top11, r8-63; |M1|, sqrt(M0 M2)) plus sum pT[all] (M0) and N[all]; constants removed. pT in GeV, r = Delta R to the stored axis in rad. The 383 Q observables are not used (they cannot be recomputed on edited jets).
naming_fit: MARS forward selection as jetdistill.mars.fit_neuron (candidates Q, max(0, Q - t), max(0, t - Q) at the 19 knots of mars.thresholds; products of a chosen hinge with a hinge of the 10 observables most correlated with the residual), selection on 4,000 fit-train jets, least-squares refit on all fit-train jets, at most 8 terms, linear target (no clipping, no ReLU on the formula, the same rule for every basis); kept length K = smallest K whose fit-dev R^2 >= max fit-dev R^2 - 0.005
naming_score: held-out R^2 of the formula on the test jets; named iff R^2 >= 0.90. Per-direction one-sided bootstrap p for H0: R^2 < 0.90 (p = (1 + #{R^2_b < 0.90}) / (B + 1)); BH at 0.05 within each basis instance (secondary count)
description_length: K (terms) and atoms (1 per linear term, 2 per hinge, sum of factors for a product); mean over named directions
causal_test: for each named direction: top term by |coef| x s.d.; window w = that term's rank window ('all' for |M1|, sqrt(M0 M2)); edits on the causal jets: pT x 1.1 of the real particles in w (then re-sorted by pT) and (Delta eta, Delta phi) x 1.1 of the particles in w; the edit used is the one with the larger mean |predicted change| / s.d.(direction); untestable if that is < 0.02. Predicted change = formula(edited) - formula(original); actual change = direction value of the network on the edited jet - original. Slope = OLS slope of actual on predicted over jets, 95 % bootstrap CI (500 jet resamples, rng(13)); pass iff the CI lies inside [0.8, 1.2]. Per-direction equivalence p = max(P_b(slope <= 0.8), P_b(slope >= 1.2)) (floor 1/501), BH within basis instance (secondary).
causal_controls: (i) mismatched formula: slope of the direction's actual change on the predicted change of another named direction's formula in the same basis instance (one derangement, rng(17)) under the same edit, same pass rule; (ii) random rotation of every real particle about the axis (angle U(0, 2 pi), rng(19); every library observable unchanged, predicted change 0): median |actual change| / s.d. vs under the chosen edit
metrics_per_basis: fraction named (of the basis's directions), fraction causally passing (of all directions; and of the named), mean K and atoms of the named
statistics: native - rotation (mean over rotations): point, 95 % jet-bootstrap CI; permutation p over the 20 rotations p = (1 + #{rotation fraction >= native}) / 21 (floor 0.048); SAE - native and PCA - native paired over the bootstrap: point, CI, two-sided bootstrap p; cross-model native differences (JEDI S vs Deep Sets S, vs PFN L) paired over the same test jets and bootstrap weights; Holm over the headline tests in the combine step
accuracy_check: JEDI-linear accuracy on the fit sample within 80.6-81.3 %
expected_under_thesis: JEDI native fraction named >= 0.6 and above every rotation (p < 0.05); SAE top-k - native <= 0.1; Deep Sets / PFN native below their SAE and within the rotation range
expected_under_alternative: sum pooling makes any basis equally nameable: JEDI native within the rotation range, or Deep Sets / PFN native equal to JEDI native
